summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-D, a $1,997,210,000 auto-loan ABS offering across seven note classes (A-1 through C) with coupons of 4.277% to 5.49% and a SOFR+0.40% floater. Public pricing is par to 99.9684%, with underwriting discounts of 0.10% to 0.36%. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account of at least $5,121,063.97, excess interest, subordination, and overcollateralization. Plans from BNP Paribas, BofA, Scotiabank, SocGen and US Bancorp. This is a routine term securitization, not a special situation. Watch collateral performance and any retained subordinated tranches.
